# Synthwave '84

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-synthwave-84)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-synthwave-84)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-synthwave-84)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-synthwave-84)

Synthwave '84 is a **dark** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-synthwave-84 codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `synthwave84` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { synthwave84 } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-synthwave-84';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, synthwave84],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `synthwave84` | `Extension` |
| `synthwave84MergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#262335` |
| Active line | `#272236` |
| Selection | `#3a2f56` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.54:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#ff7edb` | bold | 6.74:1 | 6.77:1 | 5.38:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#ff7edb` | bold | 6.74:1 | 6.77:1 | 5.38:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#72f1b8` | - | 10.91:1 | 10.95:1 | 8.71:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#939bce` | - | 5.69:1 | 5.72:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#ffffff` | - | 15.28:1 | 15.35:1 | 12.20:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#f97e72` | - | 6.01:1 | 6.03:1 | 4.80:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#72f1b8` | - | 10.91:1 | 10.95:1 | 8.71:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#36f9f6` | - | 11.67:1 | 11.72:1 | 9.32:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#fede5d` | - | 11.51:1 | 11.56:1 | 9.19:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#fede5d` | italic | 11.51:1 | 11.56:1 | 9.19:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#f97e72` | italic | 6.01:1 | 6.03:1 | 4.80:1 |
| String | `string` | `#72f1b8` | - | 10.91:1 | 10.95:1 | 8.71:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#ff6ad5` | - | 6.02:1 | 6.05:1 | 4.81:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#f97e72` | - | 6.01:1 | 6.03:1 | 4.80:1 |
| Boolean | `bool` | `#f97e72` | - | 6.01:1 | 6.03:1 | 4.80:1 |
| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#ffffff` | - | 15.28:1 | 15.35:1 | 12.20:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#8b9ae1` | italic | 5.68:1 | 5.71:1 | 4.54:1 |

| Heading | `heading` | `#ff7edb` | bold | 6.74:1 | 6.77:1 | 5.38:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#ffffff` | background, active line, selection | 12.20:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#8b9ae1` | gutter | 6.13:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#ff7edb` | background, active line | 6.74:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#ff7edb` | background | 6.74:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #72f1b8` | background, active line | 10.91:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#36f9f6, 1px solid #36f9f6` | background (fill or outline) | 11.67:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#3a2f56` | active line | 1.26:1 | Pass |
